prompt:
OCC noncombat HD2D prop library. TRUE 32-bit-era low-resolution PIXEL ART GAME SPRITE, NOT painted illustration. Every contour visibly stair-stepped with coarse square pixel blocks. Broad flat pixel clusters, sparse clean internal details, narrow dark pixel contour, hard abrupt shade steps using a restrained cohesive palette. No smooth curves, no brush texture, no realistic wood grain, no canvas grain, no antialiasing, no soft gradients, no photorealistic metal reflection. Ivory paper, dark walnut, desaturated teal and sparse muted brass. Neutral upper-left simple 3-tone form shading. Camera-parallel main writing face, front facing zero yaw; thin visible perimeter thickness. Single isolated complete object on genuine transparent background. No glow, no haze, no cast shadow, no floor. Generous clean blank area for live Chinese text; no letters, no pseudo-writing. Use the provided approved sprites as style references for their actual coarse pixel art and simple material clusters; create an independent new asset, not a redraw of the same small sprite. Larger display object may have more pixels, but must retain the same deliberately low-resolution pixel-art language.
Match the reference book's COARSE PIXEL CLUSTERS AND STEPPED OUTLINE. Not a smooth detailed painted object. Use sparse large square pixels, broad flat colors, no microscopic fabric texture or wood grain. Maintain similar apparent pixel density to the book. STYLE REFERENCE ONLY.
SUBJECT: A compact arched walnut calibration rack with broad recognizable hand tools hanging from brass loops and an ivory ceramic conductor cradle on the base. Muted cyan conductor coil. Open gaps, curved silhouette, clean practical magical engineering. Complete stable base. Not a UI rectangle.
style_policy: 32-bit-era coarse pixel art; preserve existing pixel language, no forced 32x32 canvas
